_comment: What a HANDSHAKED PEER sees — GET /api/manifest/hotel-krafft@example.com.
Compare with hotel-krafft.card.json, the public Card: the transcripts folder
appears HERE and nowhere in the Card. That is the whole point of visibility:
'shared'. The filtering is done by ClaudeConnect's existing authz read check
in server/routes/manifest.py — no new access-control code is required.
Contents arrive as ciphertext; only a peer holding a wrapped master key decrypts.

withheld.note: Present in the vault, excluded from this manifest by authz. The requester is not told what these are, only that the manifest is filtered.

contact_released._comment: Gated channels, released because this peer handshaked. The public Card showed mobile as empty with contact_sharing.mobile = confirm; here it has a value.
